neighbours.label: the slot that introduces the gear or instrument used to carry out a practical activity ('caught using ___', 'fishermen use ___', 'requires ___ and ___'), as against naming the activity's products or setting
fire: Lobsters along this coast are trapped using wooden cages left overnight.
Farmers in the valley still harvest the rice using hand sickles.
The divers collected the coral samples using small steel chisels.
Oysters here are gathered using long iron rakes at low tide.
Surveyors map the old quarry using drones and laser scanners.
The beekeepers calm the hives using smoke from burning straw.
Shrimp in the bay are caught using fine mesh nets towed behind boats.
Workers drilled the tunnel using a huge rotating cutting head.
quiet: Lobsters along this coast are sold to restaurants in the city.
Farmers in the valley still grow rice on terraced hillsides.
The divers saw bright coral near the edge of the reef.
Oysters here are popular with tourists in the summer months.
Surveyors visited the old quarry last spring with the owners.
The beekeepers sell their honey at the Saturday market.
Shrimp in the bay have become scarce in recent years.
Workers finished the tunnel two months ahead of schedule.
